name: Raglan-knee 3R (pin-knee leader with links bent along the lines of least skin motion)
family: offset 3R, exact 2-slide subfamily, planar revolute closure
bench: Bench(60,160) fast grid, pin-knee rules (jam, crowns, strap tops, every part pair, 10 fps continuity)
verdict: routing is a small lever on the leader, the seat move found with it a bigger one: raglan map argmax = the great circle at the k4216 seats; routes only 24.79 fast (25.89 at fixed part sizes; 32.33 frozen Bench(110,360) exact, 33.41 fixed) vs the pin knee 26.34 / 33.84; CMA seats + routes (A2, 1009 tries, converged) 23.00 fast (score 91.64; 23.62 at fixed sizes; same seats with straight links 24.49: J3 3.3 deg more proximal brings hub 3 / knee / pad into band); posterior-J1 seats dead (122.45); A2 worn FROZEN on Bench(110,360) exact 31.52 (score 88.54; 32.11 at fixed sizes; in-band 0.90 met, reach 0.600 = 30 of the 31.5 points) vs the pin knee 33.84 and osn 42.59 - best large-bench number so far, unverified
limiter: J2 fold: 139 of 470 big-bench poses (reach 0.600, overhead 0.25); routes and seat moves cannot touch it; near-touch: 0.12 mm min, 65.38 with metal < 2 mm as contact
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid, pin-knee rules (jam, crowns, strap tops, every part pair, 10 fps continuity); parity at d = 0 exact (26.34); 27 first-round CMA tries ran on the exact path (no bench-cache link) and are logged as not comparable; ranking by the dilution-corrected gap_fixed_n is the honest one

exact_frozen_summary.bench: Bench(110,360) exact, shape frozen from the Bench(60,160) fast fit

cma_round2.gate: converged per stream (gain over 2nd half <= 0.10, last third <= 0.03, top 5 within 0.01)

mechanism.notes: the pin-knee leader with raglan-routed links (one planform tangent arc per link, one rigid bent bar each: no extra part). bodies: link 1, link 2, member 3 (hub-3 lower plate + E strap), knee link, arm pad (arm-end, on the cuff / BOTTOM). joints: J1-J3 O20 hubs, knee pins a, b parallel to J3 (iglidur pin: GSM sleeve + 2 GTM washers on an integral Ti pin, stk 5; counted as bearing-supported revolutes). Open chain, GH closes it (loop mobility 3, nothing sags). sensed: both knee pins - parallel to J3, they add to the arm's twist (q3' = q3 + phi), so tracking the arm needs them read (or the closure solved with GH known). custom: base, 2 links, member 3, knee link, arm pad, 3 hub shafts, 2 Ti pins (est.); catalogue: 3 x MR117 pair + 2 x (GSM sleeve + 2 GTM washers) (est.).
